reviews.title: Best Mental Health App
reviews.text: After trying and failing to stay in a routine with other apps, this one actually kept me coming back. I feel rewarded for doing my daily check ins and the workouts are so easy to do. I love that you can customize your morning and evening routines. Also the aesthetic is just so cute, I come back wanting to see my duck and feed her. The community is also so supportive, it really makes you feel less alone. thank you Quabble developers for making such an amazing app that genuinely helps me with my anxiety and ocd.

reviews.title: Helped my anxiety
reviews.text:
I was so desperate to find some way to manage my spiraling anxiety, using several techniques on my own before looking to see if there was an app that could help. I tried Quabble and instantly fell in love with my duck companion and several of the exercises. I have been using the app for about a month and have noticed improvements to managing my anxiety. Thank you Quabble!

My biggest complaint is I don’t personally find all the workouts helpful (mostly the sleep ones) but maybe that is just a me thing.

reviews.title: Please get this app if you're considering !!
reviews.text:
I switched over to this app from Finch, and it is SO much better...  Finch was really overstimulating, but this app is so calming and nice..  It has really significantly helped my mental health and even physical !  

I struggle with OCD and Schizoaffective (depressive type) (schizophrenia with depression) and anxiety, and this app has helped me greatly in handling that.

Setting goals has helped me stay on my medication and not forget to take em, it's helped me appreciate things more, and just so much more..

I would reccomend this app for ANYONE who is struggling mentally..

reviews.title: Great app, still a WIP
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for a while now, and I love it. I love the community, I love the science backed features, I love the little duck and park that act as a reward system. It’s helping me keep my mental health on track. I can see this app is still a work in progress, and I love seeing the new features roll out.

There’s only a handful of minor issues. Sometimes I’ll notice that certain features I expect aren’t there, like back buttons for new workouts. But I know the team is still updating things. I also noticed today that the “safe place” workout offers an AI image generative feature. I’d like to remind the team at Quabble that the use of image generative AI features is not something your target audience (teens and young adults) enjoys. It has many negative impacts on the world that could weigh on users. I suggest removing all AI features, or having an option to do so.

Great work guys! I really do love this app.

reviews.title: An amazing app & some suggestions
reviews.text:
This app is truly amazing!! I loveee this app! Many mental health apps honestly aren’t helpful, but this one is so nice!! The workouts are brilliant. Additionally, this app has really helped me with my mental health compared to other apps! I’d recommend this app for anyone and everyone!! It’s really just a really amazing app.

However I did have some suggestions- I hope that’s alright lol:

- Adding a journal feature. This could also just have prompts for people who’d rather use a physical journal.
- More depression focused workouts.
- The addition of workouts that help with those with inattentive ADHD with a target on focusing, getting started on tasks, and executive dysfunction. I don’t find the focus timer helpful and I have inattentive ADHD.
-Allowing more than one workout to be displayed on the workout widget, and allowing the widget to link to a workout section- such as “Calm Anxiety”. 
- Workouts that focus on building confidence and self esteem.
- More integration with Apple Shortcuts and deep linking stuff. It’d be nice for people to be able to make their own workflows and shortcuts that allow them to get to specific workouts or workout sections. It really allows for a lot more customization.

This app is truly incredible though!! I just had some suggestions to make the app better for those who are neurodivergent .
